styles.name: Black 100% polyester bib apron with non tangle waist ties and a self fabric neck strap — Tibard, Shake Shack
styles.desc: BIB APRON · Self fabric neck strap · Black non tangle tape waist ties · No pocket · Tibard printed care label, no logo · No embroidery
styles.lectra: SHAAP0542 — the sheet names the pattern SHAAP0542 at A6 and SHAPP0542 at B18; the code took its extra P on 15/3/21
fabrics: Black Plaza 100% polyester 200 gsm, 1.5 m width (Rubitex) — rating 0.45 m, the same as All Costings; the sheet gives the location as B2, Sage holds the cloth at B6
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BLACK 09700 — cost per metre

Tibard printed care label, set to the right side seam as worn, 4 cm down from the finished top of the side seam: 100% polyester · 50° wash short cycle · no bleach · 1 dot iron · tumble dry · P dry clean. Printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape.
Black non tangle tape, cut 100 cm, two per apron. Sage holds black non tangle tape only as the OH-branded CMP-OH-NTT-25-03: use that code if it is the same tape.
mfg: Make the neck strap: fold in half and enclose the raw edges. Edgestitch the long edge to close the seam, and edgestitch 2 mm neatly along the folded side of the neck strap.
Set the bib facing and insert the neck strap.
Bib facing: fold in 10 mm to neaten the lower edge. Edgestitch the lower edge of the facing, which forms a 3 cm topstitch on the front.
Top of the bib: 2 mm topstitched neatly.
Armholes: double turned and topstitched to finish 1 cm from the edge. Neaten the armholes before the side seams are neatened.
Hem: double turned and topstitched to finish 12 mm from the edge.
Sides: double turned and topstitched to finish 12 mm from the edge. Insert the waist ties. Insert the care label to the right side as worn, 4 cm down from the top edge.
Fold each waist tie back on itself to fall away from the garment and edgestitch down to the width of the strap to secure.
fin: Bartack the base of each neck strap: horizontal, along the stitch line on the bib (2).
Bartack each waist tie: vertical, on the side seam stitches (2). 4 bartacks in all.

styles.note: Stock works order for SHAAPP054203, the Shake Shack black 100% polyester bib apron (original sheet Jennifer 12/6/13; updated Yvonne 10/12/20; YL added the extra P to the code and locked the sheet 15/3/21; processed by Gail). No embroidery and no logo: a plain Tibard-labelled apron. Rating 0.45 m on POPLAZA03, the same as All Costings. The black non tangle tape has no plain Sage code, so the ties are left uncoded. A sample is available. The sheet is in works-orders/SHAAPP054203-ShakeShack.xlsx.
